reviewText: The card sorting feature is super smooth. No lag at all on my phone.
Auto sorting fast kaam karti hai, card arrange karne me time waste nahi hota. Free practice tables are good to warm up before weekly tournaments.
The table aesthetics are very premium and matches load fast. Only thing is card layout could have slightly larger font sizes for comfortable viewing during long sessions.
Card dealing animation is super smooth on my OnePlus. Rummy school tutorials are great for clearing rules about points calculation. Mast app hai!
I started in the Rummy School to learn the basics, and now I feel confident playing against others. The interface is very clean and easy to navigate for beginners like me.
Points Rummy games are very fast and exciting. Perfect for killing time during my commute.
Bohot sahi app hai! Playing with real people feels very authentic and the animations are crisp. Zero heating issues on my device.
Good experience overall. The matchmaking is very quick, though I wish there were more tournament themes for the weekend. Still, a solid game for casual play.
